page.notes: Marginal notes read "Pauli III. Papatus.", "De eo testimonia libri Italici,", and "Simonia ejus à Pallavicino nequiter defensa." The last word of the third note is uncertain, so it is marked [?] in the text reading. The second and third notes may be written as one block by the printer. Hyphen-broken words are kept with their printed hyphens.
